description: This PHP source file defines the I18NDao class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling database operations related to internationalization (i18n) languages and translation messages. It provides methods to retrieve language entities by code and fetch translation messages, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database interaction.

classes.name: I18NDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling internationalization language and translation message queries.

methods.name: getLanguageByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves an I18NLanguage entity by its language code if it is enabled.

methods.name: getAllTranslationMessagesByLangCode
methods.description: Fetches all translation messages associated with a given language code, including their source units, target translations, and group names.

methods.name: createQueryBuilderWrapperForAllTranslationByLangCode
methods.description: Creates a query builder wrapper to fetch translation messages for a specific language code, validating the language and joining translation data.

calls: $q->select('langString.unitId', 'langString.value AS source', 'translation.value AS target', 'module.name AS groupName')
